cohort: This study included 280 one-year-old infants, divided into two groups: low birth weight and normal birth weight.
finding: The study found a significant relationship between low birth weight and developmental delay in various areas, including gross motor skills and problem-solving, emphasizing the importance of monitoring and early intervention for low birth weight infants.
birth_weight: low and normal (mean weight of the entire cohort: 640.9 +/- 2696.9 grams)
